settings.title: System settings

mandate.title: Autonomy mandate
mandate.hint: What ZIBBY may do unprompted. Conservative by default: dispatch on, replies off — a reply only goes out after you opt in per channel.

chat.title: Chat personality
chat.hint: How ZIBBY sounds when you talk to it. Only the tone changes — the rules for when to answer / ask / dispatch a task stay the same. Applies to the next conversation.

personaDesc.jarvis: A butler with character — warm, human, dry wit and foresight. Default.
personaDesc.concise: Minimal words, no filler, straight to the point.
personaDesc.formal: Neutral and professional, matter-of-fact and polite, no humour.

research.title: Research & intelligence
research.hint: What ZIBBY watches for you. The nightly digest ranks each source against your interests and folds the top items into the morning briefing.
research.interestsHint: Comma-separated terms the digest ranks against
research.financeWatchHint: Surface market signal in the overview — never advice.

runtime.title: Runtime parameters
runtime.hint: Formerly environment variables, now file-backed config. Interval and adapter-mode changes apply immediately (the schedulers re-arm); goal auto-resume applies on the next restart.
runtime.limitResumeMaxHint: How many times a limit-paused run is retried before it is parked/failed.
runtime.goalVerifyTimeoutHint: Wall-clock deadline for a goal verifier shell, then SIGTERM→SIGKILL.
runtime.goalAutoResumeHint: Enable for unattended (launchd) mode — running/limit-paused goals re-dispatch on restart. Off = they park and wait for approval (Law 3).

settings.languageHint: Full interface translation is rolling out gradually — Czech and English are available for now.
settings.caffeinateHint: Keeps the daemon running overnight for scheduled agent runs.
settings.footer: ZIBBY — Zestful Intuitive Brainy Butler for You

activity.hint: What shows in the live log on the right. Visible = each entry on its own line, Grouped = collapsed into one counted row, Hidden = not shown in the log at all.

gates.title: Approval rules
gates.subtitle: Global rule catalog = matcher → decision (→ resolution for ask). Evaluated top-down; first match wins.
gates.hierarchyNote: Hierarchy: system floor (POLICY.md) → this catalog → an agent's/skill's own rules. Each action is matched top-down; first match decides. Linking happens in the agent or skill editor.
gates.emptyDesc: Add your first global approval rule — then link it to specific agents and skills.
gates.evalNote: Risk is a property of (action, target, context) — not of a tool. The locked floor may only be hardened.
gates.inheritedNote: Security floor from POLICY.md — an agent may only harden it, never loosen it.
gates.noInherited: No system rules — the floor is empty.
gates.linkedNote: From the Approval rules page — edit them there; they apply everywhere they are linked.
gates.noOwnRules: No own rules — this agent runs on the system floor only.
gates.violation: Rejected — a rule would weaken the locked floor (harden-only).
